summary: Phase 2 (Dijital Vergi Dairesi e-Tebligat, DVD_MOCK_MODE=true) backend + frontend fully tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_dvd_etebligat.py pass — credential vault CRUD, Fernet at-rest encryption, no-plaintext-in-response guarantee, empty-body 400, e-Tebligat check BASARILI (new_count=2), dedup (new_count=0 on 2nd call), record listing, PDF served from disk with %PDF magic, all 4 controlled scenarios (fail/mfa/down/empty), client isolation (disjoint remote_tebligat_id sets), /etebligat/overview {mock:true}, POST /etebligat/check bulk results, audit_logs contain etebligat_sync + dvd_credentials_update entries with NO secrets. Frontend: /etebligat page renders MOCK MOD badge, checkbox selection + bulk check works; /mukellefler/{id} → tab-etebligat opens, dvd-cred-btn dialog saves creds, etebligat-check-btn fills table, etebligat-pdf-0 button present.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (by testing agent): /etebligat page crashed with 'Uncaught TypeError: destroy is not a function' because `const load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` returned a Promise and `useEffect(load, [])` treated the Promise as a cleanup function. Fixed by wrapping call: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` in /app/frontend/src/pages/Etebligat.js and same pattern in /app/frontend/src/components/ClientEtebligat.js.
server.py grew to ~1361 lines — consider splitting DVD/e-Tebligat routes into a dedicated router module.
download_etebligat_pdf path traversal check uses startswith(f'{cid}/') on normalized path — good; but abs_path is not verified to be inside UPLOAD_DIR (defense-in-depth: use os.path.commonpath).
_decrypt_creds silently swallows InvalidToken per-field; consider surfacing a health/re-key warning to admin.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created encrypted dvd_credentials for the first two active clients and inserted mock e-Tebligat records (deterministic, dedup verified). UI test also PUT UI_TEST_KOD_A creds and ran a check. Records left in-place per request; main agent will clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route paths in frontend are Turkish: /mukellefler (NOT /clients), /mukellefler/{id}, /etebligat, /beyannameler, /edefter, /gib, /gorevler, /cari, /tahsilatlar, /takvim, /raporlar, /bildirimler, /asistan, /personel, /audit. Login: after Giriş, app lands on '/' (dashboard), not '/dashboard'. e-Tebligat mock produces exactly 2 records per unique kullanici_kodu (dedup by client_id + remote_tebligat_id). PDF button in ClientEtebligat is <Button onClick={dl(id)}> not an <a href>, so href attribute is null — verify PDF via backend GET /clients/{cid}/etebligat/{eid}/document (returns %PDF from disk).
rca_of_the_issue: Runtime crash 'destroy is not a function' on /etebligat: React expects useEffect callback to return either undefined or a cleanup function. Etebligat.js used `useEffect(load, [])` where load was an arrow expression returning a Promise (from api.get(...).then(...)). At unmount, React invoked the Promise as a cleanup function → TypeError. Fixed by wrapping in a block-body callback so the effect returns undefined.
